synthetic_input_only: train RGB, calibrated camera and timestamp; evaluation_only is forbidden during initialization/training
static_alpha_regularization_scope: train-inferred geometric confidence>=0.9 only, not full-image alpha-one
RGB_objective: 0.8 full-image L1 +0.2 DSSIM; identical in both arms
nuisance_semantics: per-image appearance explanation with unknown physical identity; not a body count, trajectory, material or force

synthetic_promotion_gate.additional_requirement: finite native gradients/recovery, static/native image review and depth/alpha audit; composite PSNR is insufficient; empty support is failure

real_promotion_gate: clear native artifact reduction without lost structures, and neither common CT nor broad inferred validation PSNR falls more than0.3dB below matched full-RGB control; inferred metrics remain proxies, not geometry GT
